reasoning_content:
The generate-app-wrapper requires wget. Let me install wget to make `mise run start` work. This is a prerequisite missing. Let's install wget.

Also fnox is a tool required for some tasks but not in the registry. Let me try installing fnox separately from its release. But fnox isn't essential for core install. Let me first install wget and test start.

action.command: apt-get install -y -qq wget 2>&1 | tail -2; command -v wget; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && timeout 120 mise run generate-app-wrapper 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; ls -la .app-wrapper/wrapper/ 2>/dev/null | head
